status.description: skipped = harness policy noop (e.g. read_after_complete); not a tool failure.

policy.description: Optional policy id when status=skipped (read_after_complete, read_overlap, read_budget).

truncated.description: Alias of is_truncated for CSI/read_file probes (Wave 3 W7).

outline_count.description: Wave 3 W7: number of outline symbols attached on truncated code reads.

chars_read.description: CTX-9: characters returned in this read_file window (not full file dump on the event).

file_chars.description: CTX-9: total characters of the source file when known (for coverage = chars_read cumulative / file).

next_offset.description: Continuation line for truncated read_file; omit when complete.

path.description: Workspace path for write_file / edit_file (projection / Ops).

old_text.description: Prior span or file preview for write/edit (sticky apply without approval.requested).

new_text.description: New span or file preview for write/edit.

subagent_id.description: Present when the event originates from a nested delegate sub-agent.

cold_start.description: CSI: language server cold start on this call.

degraded_reason.description: CSI: why structural lane degraded (timeout, unsupported, …).

unsupported.description: CSI: language/path unsupported by structural provider.

applies.description: edit_file: whether the span was applied to disk.

impact.description: CSI Wave1: compact Impact projection for Ops (not full references).

checks.description: CSI Wave2: compact Verify projection for Ops (not full new_issues).

candidate_count.description: edit_file span miss / non-unique: number of candidate locations echoed.

related_tests_count.description: Wave 3 W8: number of related test paths attached to a successful code edit.

related_tests_commands.description: Wave 4 W11: copy-pasteable pytest commands attached to edit (≤5); used for adoption probes.

has_test_summary.description: Wave 4 W10: whether a parseable test_summary was attached to run_tests / testish run_command.

test_summary.description: Wave 4 W10: compact test report for Ops/CSI (not full stdout).

verify_receipt.description: Wave 4 W9: true when a one-shot verify_receipt was injected at Turn final edge.

command.description: run_tests / run_command display command (Wave 4 adoption / D1 fingerprints).

match_count.description: edit_file: how many times old_text matched when non-unique.

redirected_from.description: CSI Locate: tool that was redirected (e.g. grep → search_codebase).

locate_incomplete.description: CSI Locate: no definitions; lexical fallback only.

definition_count.description: CSI Locate: number of definitions returned.

candidates_from.description: CSI Locate incomplete echo source (e.g. ast_index).
